The '''NA LCS 2014 Summer''' Split was the fourth split of the [[North American League of Legends Championship Series]] (NA LCS). It featured eight professional teams competing in a quadruple round-robin group stage, with each team playing 28 matches. The top six teams advanced to the single-elimination playoffs, culminating in a best-of-five final to determine the split champion. The tournament took place from May 23 to September 1, 2014, in Los Angeles, United States, and awarded a total prize pool of $100,000. The Summer Split also served as part of the qualification process for the [[World Championship/2014|2014 World Championship]].
